name: Quadpro ITeS Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Quadpro ITeS Ltd offers consulting, technology, outsourcing, and next generation digital services and software.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
QPIL provides banking back-end processing solutions and also CTS solution to a consortium of banks in South India.
 It offers end-to-end solutions for customers in Banking, Insurance, and the Telecom domain.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.68 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.57%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -9.33% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.96% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.55 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 154 days.
